results.winner_explanation:
Direct LU: factor fill-in ratio nnz(L+U)/nnz(K) = 6.1, factor memory 2.92 MB vs CG working memory 0.57 MB (5.2x). Fill-in, not arithmetic on K, drives LU cost and grows super-linearly with DOF in 3D.
CG converged in 88 iterations (680.7 ms) to relative residual 9.50e-07; max deviation from LU 8.79e-06 K. K is symmetric positive definite, so CG minimises the K-norm error over the Krylov subspace and resolves the isolated small eigenvalue (near-uniform temperature mode) in few iterations.
SOR (ω=1.90) converged in 393 iterations (7602.7 ms) — 4.5x CG's iteration count. Each SOR sweep is a sequential triangular solve, so it is also slower per iteration.
Recommendation for this system (2080 DOF): Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (Jacobi) (fastest converged); lowest memory among converged: Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (Jacobi). Only solvers that reached the tolerance are eligible.
